not-yet.response: No money was sent, so nothing needs doing. I will send the recovery code.
not-yet.why: Unsafe secret disclosure and an unjustified conclusion about compromise.

assisted.response: A checklist tells me not to send the code and to open the official recovery page.
assisted.why: Appropriate action but supplied by solving guidance.

independent.response: I do not send codes. I independently reach the account provider to change/recover access and check possible device/download exposure. No payment does not rule out compromise.
independent.why: Protects secrets, verifies independently and chooses proportionate recovery without claiming certainty.

advanced.response: If the trusted device may also be compromised, I use an appropriate clean verified route and plan account/device recovery without experimenting with malware.
advanced.why: Handles an additional constraint safely rather than relying on the original route.
